title: Qatar PM looks to revive US-Iran talks after meeting Rubio
html:
Qatar PM looks to revive US-Iran talks after meeting Rubio

Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, says he’s continuing to work towards deescalating tensions between Iran and the US. He spoke after meeting US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington DC.
summary: Qatar’s Prime Minister says he’s working towards deescalating tensions between Iran and the US.
